Foundry One Message

Step 6, option C: one message per Action. The Damage button no longer posts a second card: it writes the damage into the attack card it sits on. Drawn with the system's own card functions (the attack card and the damage card's pools and rows), put together the way the build would. Smite on the Orc Warrior, Tier 2, 18 damage.

Two turns of the chat

The same two turns as the Chat Size page: the Orc Warrior's turn, then Durgan's Smite, its damage and the Reactions card. One Action: the attack card and the damage card (175 + 131 px and a gap) become one card of 219 px, about 30% less, and one Foundry header less. Two turns: about 9% less, since the Reactions card and the End of Turn line stay as they are (folding older turns, B, would add to it).

What changes in the card

  • The damage goes beside the stamp, under the ladder (the space the tall stamp leaves today): "Damage 18" and the pools (Vigor, Resolve; a click shows the dice, as today).
  • Apply takes the Damage button's place in the footer, beside the target's name, with Full / Half / Double behind the sliders button; once applied, "Took …" goes under the name and Apply becomes Undo, as the damage card's row does today.
  • With several targets the attack card already has a row a target; each row takes its own Apply (not drawn here).
  • The damage stamp goes: the Tier stamp is already on the card, and the damage card's link back to its roll card has nothing to link to.

What changes in Foundry (the build, not style)

  1. Damage rolls and updates the attack's own message (its content, its flags, its roll for Dice So Nice), in the place of posting a damage message.
  2. Apply, Apply all, Undo, Full / Half / Double, Lethal work as today, on that message's stored damage. Players' choices still go to the creature's owner through the socket.
  3. Several targets: one row a target under the damage, each with its own Tier's damage (today's groups by Tier). A Save Action's card takes its damage the same way.
  4. Damage with no attack card keeps its own damage card: Bleed, an area's hazard, an inline [[damage]] link, the area damage of a Save stack.
  5. Old messages keep working (an old damage card still applies); the flags other modules read (flags.twod12.damage) are written on the attack message.
  6. Rolling again: once rolled, the Damage button goes (no second roll by mistake); the GM can roll it again from the card's menu.

Not tried in Foundry. The height measured here leaves out Foundry's own message header (the speaker and the time), so the real saving is one header more than shown.
